svg.aria-label: A touchless sorting line. Fourteen gates stand along a conveyor, one for each stage of the DocBits pipeline path from Intake to ERP Acknowledgement. Documents still on the belt are in progress. A pusher at the Field Validation gate sends a blocked document sideways into the review tray; the review stack holds the AP assisted and process exception documents. Documents that pass every gate reach the export bin, whose stack holds pure touchless documents with the approval-only documents on top. A dial reads the touchless rate, the export stack divided by both stacks, 78.9 percent, past the 70 percent target mark.
